sheets.title: Conceptual Land-Use Plan
sheets.note: Illustrative land-use zones: marina and waterfront recreation, residential, residential/commercial, mixed-use/commercial, a market, festival and agricultural area, and open space/conservation.

sheets.title: Conceptual Lot Layout
sheets.note: Illustrative street and lot arrangement for approximately 300 homesites, with waterfront, lake-view and interior lots around preserved open space.

sheets.title: Site Topography (Preliminary)
sheets.note: Preliminary elevation map of the property, shaded from low ground near the water (blue) to higher ground (green). Not a survey; a full topographic survey will be provided separately.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Davis Road & Snake Road, Limestone County, Alabama

facts.label: Waterfront
facts.value: About one mile on Lake Wheeler (Tennessee River), east of the Elk River confluence

facts.label: Access & utilities
facts.value: Two county roads; water and power available along both

facts.label: Drive times
facts.value: About 15 minutes to Athens and 25 minutes to Huntsville

facts.label: Current use
facts.value: Pasture, hay fields and mature hardwood forest; held by one family for 75+ years

facts.label: Concept program
facts.value: Approximately 300 homesites (townhomes to one-acre estate lots), marina and waterfront recreation, mixed-use/commercial and open space

facts.label: Shoreline
facts.value: Lake Wheeler is a TVA reservoir; docks and other shoreline structures require TVA Section 26a approval

disclaimer: Sadler Farms represents a potential development opportunity. All plans, layouts, lot counts, uses and renderings are conceptual and illustrative only, are not engineered or surveyed, and are subject to planning, engineering, governmental approvals and permitting. Acreage, shoreline length, utilities and travel times are approximate and should be independently verified.
